text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac wasn't feeling well, so we 
came to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No need to fret over me, please. I'll be 
right as rain after a little rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, what a wonderful stand-up routine 
full of love! Thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's move on to announcing the 
scores! Judges, if you please~♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...A perfect 100 out of 100. This deserves 
to be etched into comedy history!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My score is also 100 miles! I award you 
the title of Comedy Queen! ...Ah, but I'm 
not giving up the Mile Queen title!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Could it really be~? Are we looking at our 
first perfect score!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm a 100 too... Out of a possible 120, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wh—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Whyyyyyy the heck is Ai-san the only one 
gettin' a 120 out of 100?!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
True, that was a wonderful manzai routine. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It isn't perfect.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, you should be able to aim 
even higher, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, she's always like this!! Keeping a 
straight face while saying the most 
outrageous things!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Still――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Lookin' at your eyes, you really mean it, 
don'tcha. You truly believe... that I can 
still do it—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Nggghh!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Until you can't even move—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I'll make 'em laugh!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—...Was it... just a dream...? What a 
weird dream—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Somehow, it makes me wanna go 
make Ai-san laugh.
